phone_frame.Y: device top (screen up = positive direction away from user)
phone_frame.Z: screen front face (out of screen toward user)

heading_convention.definition: Compass heading: degrees clockwise from North

rotation_convention.euler_definition: yaw_offset, then tilt pitch, then tilt roll

android_accelerometer.type: TYPE_ACCELEROMETER — total specific force including gravity
android_accelerometer.gravity_handling: gravity is NOT removed; acc_z ≈ +g when Z is up
android_accelerometer.note: Do not subtract gravity twice. The scaler trained on this convention.

android_orientation.yaw: azimuth of device Y+ (top) from North, clockwise, [0, 360°]
android_orientation.pitch: angle from horizontal plane: 0=flat, -90=vertical screen toward user
android_orientation.roll: rotation about X-axis; ill-defined when |pitch|≈90° (gimbal lock)

io_vnbd_mounting.observed_acc_z: ≈ +9.8 m/s² (phone Z ≈ up, nearly horizontal gravity component)
io_vnbd_mounting.roll_behaviour: high variance due to gimbal lock at pitch ≈ ±90°
io_vnbd_mounting.yaw_offset_per_sequence: different for each drive (different mounting per vehicle/driver)

stationary_detector.tuning_note: Thresholds set from physics, not tuned on test data.

gnss_yaw_calibration.method: circular mean of (gnss_course - phone_yaw) over all valid motion samples
